name: Phosphor
about: Phosphor is a free, open-source icon set with 9,198 icons designed by Phosphor Icons. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.a: Yes. All 9,198 Phosphor are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Phosphor in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.
There are 9,198 icons in the Phosphor set, designed by Phosphor Icons. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Phosphor?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Phosphor available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
